get.description: Retrieve current state of a viewing session.

delete.description: Close and delete a viewing session idempotently.

patch.description:
Update viewing session playback position.

Enforces:
- Bounded position within movie duration.
- Untrusted clients cannot assert verified_integration or partner_sync provenance.
- Session ownership check.

post.description:
Consume single-use server nonce to authorize full spoiler mode.

Adheres strictly to SRS-SPO-004, AC-009, AC-010.
Never treats bare boolean claims as authorization.
Immediately reset session spoiler policy back to SAFE mode.

Submit a question within a viewing session.

Delegates to RagOrchestrator to enforce:
1. Session existence and viewer ownership.
2. Server-controlled spoiler policy and playback position.
3. Pre-retrieval evidence boundary filtering (future chunks are physically excluded).
4. Single-use nonce flow for future spoiler requests.
5. Verified citation grounding and safe abstention.
